name: mpn-note
assumes: One component in the netlist that a list_components, search_components_by_*, or query_xnet_* call would otherwise return
query_component is out of scope: it describes one component and states its note once already
mpn = blank means the property is set to whitespace only
group = groupComponentsByMpn (list_components, search_components_by_*); xnet_described / xnet_bare = aggregateCircuitByMpn (query_xnet_*) for a part with / without a description
Every refdes a result lists under the MPN note shares one component_notes entry, refdes in natural order; the field is omitted when no part is listed
